description: The most uses of the legacy --ui-*, --obs-* and --agent-* variables each stylesheet may have (ui/tokens.css defines them and is not counted); a stylesheet not listed may have none, since new rules use --orchard-*. stylesheets.test.ts fails on a count above its budget and passes on one below it. The budgets only fall: a task that removes uses leaves this file alone, and pnpm postmerge lowers them to the counts on main (scripts/lib/legacy-token-budget.mjs).
